stem: Which sentence best supports the idea that the old couple is still in love after many years?

options.label: F
options.text: No, they were white, and you’ve never seen such a couple in your life—a man and his wife, and they must have been in their seventies.

options.label: G
options.text: Marge, he was lookin’ at her like every woman on earth dreams of bein’ looked at, and her eyes were doin’ the same thing back at him.

options.label: H
options.text: They started over toward the elevator and then the old lady turned away from the man and made her way over to the receptionist’s desk.

options.label: J
options.text: The couple smiled in such a dignified way, and it seemed like they hadn’t noticed a thing.
